title: Privatización
goal: Read how Argentina under Menem and Mexico under Salinas privatized major state enterprises in the early 1990s -- and the efficiency arguments for it and the corruption and job-loss controversies against it.

items: Name which Argentine companies Menem privatized, 1990-1994.
Describe what Salinas did in Mexico in 1990.
State the efficiency argument for privatization.
Explain the main controversies these sales generated.
Use en manos de to name who controls something.
